open_questions.question: After 17 August 2026, will EUNACOM homologate SP when a medical title is revalidated by an eligible State university other than Universidad de Chile?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The current EUNACOM rules name only Universidad de Chile and predate the new recognition regime; acceptance could save the entire practical examination.
open_questions.how_to_resolve: Request a dated written answer from EUNACOM/ASOFAMECH and the Subsecretaría de Educación Superior, specifically citing Decreto 174/2024 and Ley 21.325 art. 143.

open_questions.question: Does the Comptroller's 2009 limitation of automatic EUNACOM revalidación to Decreto 8 art. 12 purposes remain the authoritative interpretation after 17 August 2026?
open_questions.why_it_matters: It determines whether EUNACOM alone supports general private practice and academic-title use or only the enumerated statutory purposes.
open_questions.how_to_resolve: Obtain a post-17-August-2026 opinion from Contraloría, MINSAL, Mineduc or the Superintendencia; do not rely only on the pre-change EUNACOM website.

open_questions.question: Is EUNACOM formally administered only in Spanish, and are interpreters or language accommodations categorically unavailable?
open_questions.why_it_matters: She currently has no Spanish, while SP assesses patient communication and would be unsafe to attempt without clinical fluency.
open_questions.how_to_resolve: Ask EUNACOM in writing for its language and accommodation policy for both ST and SP.

open_questions.question: What are the July and December 2027 EUNACOM-ST dates and closing dates?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The next-12-month horizon extends through 3 September 2027, but only 16 December 2026 was officially published as of the research date.
open_questions.how_to_resolve: Monitor the dated notices on eunacom.cl; the rules require at least four months' advance announcement.

open_questions.question: Can the official Flow payment process accept a Ukrainian-issued card and a passport number without a RUT?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The rules accept a passport, but the payment processor's foreign-card and identifier requirements were not established.
open_questions.how_to_resolve: Test the payment form before the deadline or ask EUNACOM for bank-transfer or representative-payment instructions.

open_questions.question: Will CONACEM or another MINSAL-authorized entity accept and certify her Ukrainian rheumatology specialty under Ley 20.261 art. 2 bis?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Successful certification could avoid EUNACOM for specialty-limited public-sector practice, but it would not authorize general or private practice.
open_questions.how_to_resolve: Submit a document-specific pre-assessment to the authorized specialty certifier, including curriculum, training hours, specialist licence and recent practice evidence.

open_questions.question: Can EUNACOM and the Superintendencia complete RNPI reporting while she is identified only by passport and has no Chilean RUN?
open_questions.why_it_matters: EUNACOM permits passport registration, but RNPI public records ordinarily include a RUN.
open_questions.how_to_resolve: Request coordinated written confirmation from EUNACOM and the Superintendencia before relying on automatic registry entry.

open_questions.question: Does her son's status in Chile permit family reunification or another residence route?
open_questions.why_it_matters: It does not change EUNACOM eligibility, but it may simplify lawful residence, obtaining a RUN/RUT and completing repeated in-person SP stages.
open_questions.how_to_resolve: Confirm the son's citizenship or residence category, her documentary proof of relationship, and current Servicio Nacional de Migraciones rules.

unknowns_declared: No explicit current official EUNACOM language-policy clause was located; Spanish-only administration is therefore not stated as a proven rule in this lane.
No official aggregate 2025 or 2026 pass rate for foreign-trained doctors was located; the cited 44% figure is only July 2017 EUNACOM-ST and includes repeaters.
No 2027 EUNACOM-ST dates or registration windows were found as of 3 September 2026.
The current EUNACOM practical-homologation rules predate 17 August 2026 and do not say whether revalidación by another newly empowered State university will be accepted.
No post-17-August-2026 authority was found resolving whether the Comptroller's narrow 2009 interpretation of automatic EUNACOM revalidación still controls.
The fee page continues to display fixed CLP amounts effective from 1 July 2025 and publishes no UTM original; future fee changes remain possible.
It is unknown whether the Flow payment path works with a Ukrainian payment card and no RUT.
Immediate RNPI entry after passing EUNACOM while the doctor has only a passport and no Chilean RUN was not verified.
Her eligibility for the specialty-certification exception depends on a certifier's assessment of her Ukrainian rheumatology training and was not established.
Family-reunification eligibility cannot be determined without knowing her son's Chilean citizenship or residence status.
